playbookOutputs: VAT computation (output and input VAT reconciled to sales and purchase records)
playbookCommonFailures: Supplier invoices that are not valid tax invoices (no VAT number, no "tax invoice" wording, over R5,000 without recipient details) so input VAT cannot be claimed
Input VAT claimed on entertainment, passenger vehicles or private expenses
Sales records incomplete versus bank deposits, so output VAT is understated
Wrong tax period for the vendor category
Payment not made by the due date after submission

informationToProvide.label: Company Name, 10-Digit SARS VAT Number & VAT Period (YYYY-MM)
informationToProvide.helpText: Registered company name, 10-digit SARS VAT reference number (starting with 4), and the VAT period to be calculated and submitted (e.g., 2026-08).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company name, 10-digit SARS VAT registration number, and VAT201 period (YYYY-MM).

informationToProvide.label: Business Bank Statements for the Full VAT Period (PDF / CSV)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload complete bank statements for all business accounts covering the full VAT period.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Business bank statements covering the full VAT period.

informationToProvide.label: Sales Tax Invoices & Sales Summary for the VAT Period
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload all customer tax invoices or sales reports (indicating standard-rated, zero-rated, or exempt supplies) for the period.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Sales tax invoices and sales schedule for output VAT calculation.

informationToProvide.label: Supplier Tax Invoices & Expense Receipts for the VAT Period
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload all valid s20 supplier tax invoices and capital purchase invoices to support your input VAT deduction.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Supplier tax invoices and capital goods invoices for s20 input VAT audit and calculation.

informationToProvide.label: Previous Period VAT201 Return (if new client)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the prior VAT201 return if this is your first VAT period with My Accountant.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Prior period VAT201 return for continuity check.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access and sales/purchase/bank records
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Sales records, purchase records, bank statements and credentials for the period on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Confirm the tax period and the vendor's category (2-monthly or monthly). Ask for the accounting system VAT report if the client uses one; otherwise invoices and statements. Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify records cover the period and invoices are valid tax invoices
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Records cover the full period; input invoices pass tax-invoice checks; bank deposits reconcile to sales
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check each supplier invoice has the supplier VAT number, "Tax invoice" wording, date, description and VAT amount; over R5,000 needs the recipient's name/VAT number. Exclude entertainment, passenger vehicle purchases and private items (s17(2)). Compare sales total to bank deposits and list unexplained deposits.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Calculate output and input VAT
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: VAT computation prepared in the AI Accountant module and reviewed by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Pull from the AI Accountant module: standard-rated supplies (15%), zero-rated, exempt, output VAT; input VAT on goods/services and capital goods; adjustments (bad debts, change in use). Apportionment for mixed supplies is Kevin's call. Kevin reviews before it goes to the handoff sheet.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft VAT computation and VAT201 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Computation and field-by-field VAT201 values (fields 1–20) with sources
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Reconcile the computation to the accounting system VAT report where one exists and explain differences. Show amount payable/refundable and due date.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Complete and submit the VAT201 on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: VAT201 submitted; confirmation and PRN saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Returns → VAT201 → select the tax period. Enter each field from the handoff sheet and confirm the calculated net VAT equals the computation. Agent drives to the summary; Kevin reviews and presses Submit and captures the PRN. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver VAT computation, confirmation and payment details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Computation, filed VAT201, PRN, amount and due date posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Give the amount payable with the PRN and due date (last business day of the following month for eFiling ⚠ verify), or explain a refund and that SARS may request invoices before paying. Note any invoices excluded and why, so the client fixes supplier invoices going forward.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
